controls.raw:
<RouterLink
              v-for="item in entries(group)"
              :key="item.key"
              :to="to(item.key)"
              class="sd-nav-link"
              :class="{ 'sd-nav-active': activeScreen === item.key || (item.key === 'tickets' && ['detail', 'edit'].includes(activeScreen)) }"
              :aria-current="activeScreen === item.key ? 'page' : undefined"
            >
<form v-if="editor" class="grid gap-3 border-t border-n-weak mt-4 pt-4" @submit.prevent="save">

<Select v-if="rule.action === 'pause'" v-model="reason" :disabled="busy || !!pendingCommand" :placeholder="t('JRC_SERVICE_DESK.LIFECYCLE.reason')" :options="rule.reasons.map(row => ({ value: row.code, label: row.name }))" />
<Button v-for="item in items" :key="item.id" size="sm" variant="outline" :disabled="saving" :label="`${item.name} v${item.version}`" @click="edit(item)" />
<form v-if="mayCreateService" class="grid gap-3 border-t border-n-weak pt-4" @submit.prevent="createService">

<Select v-model="selected" :disabled="disabled || !unitId || status === 'loading'" :options="[{ value: '', label: t('JRC_SERVICE_DESK.LIFECYCLE.unit_policy') }, ...items.map(row => ({ value: row.id, label: row.name }))]" />
<button type="button" class="sd-text-link max-w-72 text-start line-clamp-2" @click="emit('open', ticket.id)">
<Button variant="outline" color="slate" :label="t('JRC_SERVICE_DESK.NATIVE.back_to_jrc')" @click="router.push({ name: 'home', params: { accountId: route.params.accountId } })" />

events: router.push({ name: 'jrc_service_desk_tickets', params: { accountId: session.accountId.value }, query: { unit_id: selected.unit_id, queue_id: selected.id } })
controls.raw: <Button v-if="selected && resource === 'queues'" :label="t('JRC_SERVICE_DESK.SCREENS.tickets')" @click="router.push({ name: 'jrc_service_desk_tickets', params: { accountId: session.accountId.value }, query: { unit_id: selected.unit_id, queue_id: selected.id } })" />

<button
          v-for="(label, index) in steps"
          :key="index"
          type="button"
          class="sd-wizard-step"
          :aria-current="index === step ? 'step' : undefined"
          @click="step = index"
        >
<Input v-if="!edit" v-model="draft.conversation_id" :label="t('JRC_SERVICE_DESK.OPS.conversation_id')" :disabled="!mayEdit || busy || unit?.permissions.link_conversation !== true" maxlength="19" />

methods.name: index
scope: policy_scope(::JrcServiceDesk::Unit) # Enforce and record Pundit scoped reads.

methods.name: update
authorize: authorize strict_ticket, :show? # Field-level capabilities are rechecked by UpdateTicketService.
scope: strict_ticket, :show? # Field-level capabilities are rechecked by UpdateTicketService.

methods.name: related_item
scope: strict_ticket.id.to_s, kind: kind, item: presenter.related(record, kind))
